channel.title: Lesotho - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Lesotho, every source cited.

item.title: Lesotho government allocates M50 million for Royal Palace
item.description: The Senate's Committee on Government Assurances reports on the stalled M355 million palace project and overpayments.

item.title: Lesotho names four players for AUSC Region 5 Games
item.description: Phuthi Leshoele, Lindiwe Nkanda, Thabo Chimombe, and Kamohelo Mathibela will compete in lawn tennis in Maputo, Mozambique.

item.title: Econet raises M971 000 for education fund
item.description: The annual Econet Golf Day and Expo gala dinner secured funds for vulnerable students in Lesotho.

item.title: Lesotho cricket team ends Nigeria campaign with defeat
item.description: The national side lost to Gambia by three runs, finishing fourth in the tournament standings.

item.title: China reaffirms ties and multilateralism with Lesotho
item.description: Ambassador Yang Xiaokun urged local media to respect China's sovereignty claims over Taiwan.
